name: Gonohe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Gonohe town emblem in white: a broken ring of two arcs around a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Gonohe, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1961.

features.role: Gonohe town emblem — a broken ring of two arcs around a stylised character
